# proxmox_realms (Data Source)

Lists authentication realms from the world-readable `/access/domains` login index, sorted by `realm`. The index only carries public login metadata: no bind password, client key, client certificate or digest. Use the `proxmox_realm` data source for the full configuration of one realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# The realm index is world-readable and carries only login metadata: no bind
# password, client key, certificate path or full TFA parameters.
data "proxmox_realms" "all" {}

output "realm_types" {
  value = { for realm in data.proxmox_realms.all.realms : realm.realm => realm.type }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `realms` (Attributes List) All configured realms, including the built-in `pam` and `pve` realms. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--realms))

<a id="nestedatt--realms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `realms`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Login box description, when set.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether the realm is the cluster default. Proxmox reports this flag in the index but does not document it there; treat it as a hint.
- `realm` (String) Realm identifier.
- `tfa` (String) Forced second factor (`oath` or `yubico`), when configured. The index only exposes the factor type, not its parameters.
- `type` (String) Realm type such as `ldap`, `ad`, `openid`, `pam`, or `pve`.
